senses.gloss:
(I)--One of the four forms of Hari.
1: भा. 1. 5. ३७; Vi. १६. १८; X. १६. ४५; ४०. २१; XII. ११. २१. M. २७६. 9.
In- voked as a principal divinity. Source of all sounds (शब्द- योनि); presiding over the mind as fourth in order.
2: भा. III. 1. ३४.
The supreme ruler of all senses.
3: Ib. III. २६. २८; IV. २४. ३६.
Created specially in the battle of ललिता with भण्ड.
4: Br. IV. २९. १२८.

(II)--the son of Pradyumna and Rukma- vati; carried away by air by चित्रलेखा, to the harem of the daughter of बणा at her instance. For him बाण had his arms reduced from thousand to two. Married रोचना, grand-daughter of Rukmin at भोजकट to which कृष्ण, बलराम and others went. Came back to द्वारका with his newly wedded wife.
1: भा. X. ६१. १८. २३[9], २५-26 & ४०.
Seen in a dream by उषा. Picture of him drawn by चित्रलेखा, who made him enjoy उषा's [page१-055+ ४२] company at शोणितपुर. बाण came to know of this and imprisoned him to the great regret of his daughter.
2: Ib. X. ६२. १२. २०-27, and ३५.
नारद communicated the news of Aniruddha's imprisonment to कृष्ण and वृष्णिस्. These departed to शोणितपुर, beseiged it, and humbled the pride of बाण. The latter agreed to set Aniruddha free and allow him to marry his daughter. Left for द्वारका with उष.
3: Ib. X. ch. ६३ (whole).
Famous for his speed in battle.
4: Ib. I. १४. ३०.
Unable to recover the dead child of the द्वारका Bra1h2man2a.
5: Ib. X. ८९. ३१ and ४१.
Father of Vajra.
6: Ib. X. ९०. ३३, ३६-7.
Went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for solar eclipse.
7: Ib. X. ८२. 7.
Fought with सात्यकि at प्रभासा.
8: Ib. XI. ३०, १६.
One of the five वम्शवीरस्.
9: Br. III. ७२. 2.
मृगकेतन was a son of his: an authority on architecture.
१०: M. ४७. २३; ९३. ५१; २४८. ४९; २५२. 3.

(I)--The God of Wind invoked.
1: भा. III. 6. १६.
A surname of वायु;
2: Br. II. २५. १२.
father of भीमसेन.
3: Vi. IV. १४. ३५; भा. IX. २२. २७.
(II)--a वासव: married शिवा and had two sons --Manojava and अविज्ञतगति. See इशान। Br. II. १०. ८०; III. 3. २१; M. 5. २१; २०३. 3; वा. ६६. २०, २५; Vi. I. १५. ११०, ११४.

(III)--The वायु पुराण narrated by Wind-god with समास बन्धस् and rhythm;
1: वा. 3. 8.
२३,000 stanzas.
2: वा. १०४. 7.
(IV)--a son of कृष्ण and मित्रविन्दा. भा. X. ६१. १६.
--son of अटमान and father of हालेय. भा. XII. 1. २५. [page१-056+ ३१]
--a son of first सावर्ण Manu Br. IV. 1. ६५.
--a son of Arka Agni. वा. २९. ४०; Br. II. १२. ४३.
--the continent lying round श्याम hill. M. १२२. २३.
--a son of देवानीक and father of पारियात्र. भा. IX. १२. 2.
